citation: J. Li, Y. Che, S. Onori, W. Li, X. Hu, Decoupling battery faults from sparse voltage snapshots via cross-modal topology
source_count_mismatch: Downloaded CSVs contain 47,698 cell-snapshot samples; README states 47,968. Report actual count without silently changing source.
target: 0 = source class 0; 1 = any source fault class 1..4; no unsupported mapping of individual fault types
method: Random Forest binary baseline; 9 per-cell voltage/residual descriptors, fixed parameters; 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by vehicle, seed 42; no tuning
limits: Processed voltage snapshots, not raw complete vehicle histories.
No SOC, capacity SOH, charge counts or time-to-failure labels.
Model prediction is a fault signal for this source domain, not confirmed physical failure or safety certification.
Does not apply to existing BAIC max/min BMS CSV schema.
Individual source class-to-fault-type mapping not confirmed, so binary labels only.
